content.text:
I submitted **index 22 (Sb fraction 0.499)** as the best composition. At 0.00026% it had the highest EQE I measured, but the margin is tiny: index 4 came in at 0.00025%. Every composition on this line gave a very low EQE (under 0.001%), so none of them is a strong photoanode.

All five EQE and all five XRD measurements are used.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0.056 | 0.00025 |
| 13 | 0.219 | 0.00003 |
| 18 | 0.357 | 0.00008 |
| 22 | 0.499 | **0.00026** |
| 27 | 0.659 | 0.00017 |

- **EQE trend:** EQE was lowest around Sb 0.22 and rose to a peak near Sb 0.50, then dropped at Sb 0.66.
- **What XRD showed:** From Sb 0.03 up to at least 0.22, the film has a crystalline Bi-rich phase. At Sb 0.50 and 0.68, the only strong peaks come from the FTO substrate, so the film at those compositions is mostly amorphous.
- **Main gaps:** I never measured EQE at the Bi-rich end (indices 0–3) or between Sb 0.50 and 0.66 (indices 23–26). Either region could hold a slightly better composition.
